title: Music Listening- Genre EEG dataset (MUSIN-G)
description: This dataset contains electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from 20 Indian participants who listened to 12 songs spanning genres from Indian Classical to Goth Rock. After each song, participants rated their familiarity with and enjoyment of it on a 5-point scale. The data support research on music perception, genre, and affective responses to music.
methods_description: Participants closed their eyes on hearing a single beep, and each song was played through speakers. A double beep after each song prompted them to open their eyes and rate familiarity and enjoyment on a scale of 1 (most) to 5 (least). Each session corresponds to one song.
